newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Xilinx cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Xilinx cut to hold.

text.p: -- UBS Securities analyst Charles Boucher said in a research note that he lowered his recommendation on Xilinx Inc to hold from buy following the company's announcement that its second fiscal quarter ended September 30 would be "much weaker than previously expected, with revenue down 12-13 percent sequentially and earnings per share of about $0.30 versus the previous (Wall) street consensus of $0.38 per share," according to Boucher.
-- Boucher lowered his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $1.38 per share from $1.65 and the 1998 estimate to $1.67 from $2.07.
